LLM_PROVIDER.description: Which LLM provider runs the interviews: type `openai`, `gemini` or `claude`. Then put that company's API key into the matching field above.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: If LLM_PROVIDER is `openai`, replace `none` with your key from [platform.openai.com/api-keys](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Otherwise leave `none`.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: If LLM_PROVIDER is `gemini`, replace `none` with your key from [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Otherwise leave `none`.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: If LLM_PROVIDER is `claude`, replace `none` with your key from [console.anthropic.com/settings/keys](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Otherwise leave `none`.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional. Leave `none`, or replace it with any long random text.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Leave `none`, or choose a password to download a CSV backup of all interviews at `/export?password=...`.

DB.description: Optional backup copy of every interview. Keep the suggested name.
